neighbours.label: ' risk' and similar outcome words in 'associated with higher risk of' health findings, as opposed to other mentions of risk and the same nutrients
fire: Heavy drinking is associated with increased risk of stroke.
Low vitamin D levels were linked to higher risk of falls.
Diets rich in red meat are associated with higher risk of cancer.
Night shifts were associated with greater risk of diabetes.
Studies show that obesity is tied to higher risk of dementia.
Poor sleep is associated with increased risk of heart failure.
Long sitting was associated with elevated risk of clots.
High salt intake is linked to increased risk of hypertension.
quiet: Heavy drinking is common in the town during the festival.
Low vitamin D levels were measured in winter in Norway.
Diets rich in red meat are popular in parts of Argentina.
Night shifts were paid at a higher rate than days.
Investors know that bonds carry a low risk of default.
Poor sleep is a common complaint among new parents.
Long sitting was uncomfortable on the wooden benches.
High salt intake is typical of many fast food meals.

notes: Covers a narrow part of the pole: the card's most common token is ' lead', and probes of ' lead' stayed at or below 0.14 despite a causal reading. A causal label failed in probes (0.02 to 0.23), which is why this is narrower.
